title: Composing like cycles is decided on the tops
claim: In every law that composes like cycles: (1) every reflexive pp-definable relation on a range is total or lies inside the range's top, its unique maximal proper pp-definable equivalence; (2) the top lemma: every system has exactly the circuits of its blur by any proper reflexive pp-definable relations, in particular of its image modulo the tops, so no circuit hides below the tops and a set is free exactly when its top image is full (each variable and its blurred copy are parallel in one system); (3) the top image of every tie is the graph of a bijection between the two tops; (4) at each variable of a knot the top image is functional, or every two top classes share a fibre. (5) Conjecture 6 of MALTSEV-CONDITIONS-20261021-001B-P001 is false: parity beside the isolated-value relation J, and K4 beside the Z3 law, compose like cycles, but their whole-domain top is equality and no operation is Mal'tsev there. (6) In a disjoint union every knot lies in one part, so a polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops of knot ranges passes to disjoint unions. Open: Conjecture 7 (every such law has one) and whether a knot's top image can overlap.
failure_conditions: A law that composes like cycles has a proper reflexive pp-definable relation on a range that is not inside the range's top.
A system of such a law has a circuit that is free modulo the tops, or a doubled system has a circuit whose copy is not a circuit.
A tie of such a law has a top image that is not the graph of a bijection.
A knot of such a law has a variable at which its top image is neither functional nor overlapping.
Parity beside J, or K4 beside the Z3 law, has an elimination failure or a pp-definable equivalence on its whole domain other than equality and the total relation.
A knot of a disjoint union has variables in both parts.
foundation_claim_scope: Which structure laws that compose like cycles carry on the tops of their ranges. No native recurrence, composed topology in the protected sense, path, metric distance or physical claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py re-certifies the census tops of eleven laws, checks Lemma 1 on 25,605 reflexive relations, the top lemma on 3,300 systems with blurs by the tops and by observed reflexive relations and on 440 explicit doubled systems, all 5,874 ties bijective and all 869 knots functional, every non-trivial equivalence on both union domains broken by an explicit mixed polymorphism, and the combined operations for both unions; four controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with randomized and exhaustive checks; parallel exchange in matroids cited as textbook; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: the top lemma for every law that composes like cycles, Lemma 1's strengthening of Proposition 6, the bijection of tie tops, and the refutation and repair of Conjecture 6 are new to the program; the top lemma's argument is textbook parallel exchange applied to a system and its blurred copy, so an expert would find it quickly once the question is posed; the counterexample to Conjecture 6 was already in MALTSEV-CONVERSE-20261020-001B-P001.
